stories.title: Ukraine-Russia war latest: Zelensky says Putin struck power plant hours after Trump ‘ceasefire’ announcement

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war latest: Zelensky says Putin struck power plant hours after Trump 'ceasefire' announcement
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky reported that Putin ordered an attack on a power plant shortly after Trump announced a ceasefire proposal. The ceasefire has not been confirmed by either Ukraine or Russia.

en.title: 'Tax rises needed to plug £35bn gap' and 'Putin breaks Trump's 'ceasefire'
en.summary: UK newspapers highlighted concerns about upcoming budget measures to address a £35 billion shortfall, alongside coverage of alleged Russian actions contradicting Trump's ceasefire proposal.

stories.title: Sacha Baron Cohen to star in Quentin Tarantino’s West End play The Popinjay Cavalier

en.title: Sacha Baron Cohen to star in Quentin Tarantino's West End play The Popinjay Cavalier
en.summary: Actor Sacha Baron Cohen will perform in The Popinjay Cavalier, Quentin Tarantino's debut stage play, which will premiere on London's West End in March 2027 with Tarantino also directing.

stories.title: Sacha Baron Cohen to star in Quentin Tarantino's West End play

en.title: Sacha Baron Cohen to star in Quentin Tarantino's West End play
en.summary: Sacha Baron Cohen will appear in Quentin Tarantino's West End play The Popinjay Cavalier, expressing enthusiasm about collaborating with the Pulp Fiction director on the project.

stories.title: Quentin Tarantino's first stage play will debut in London with Sacha Baron Cohen as star

en.title: Quentin Tarantino's first stage play will debut in London with Sacha Baron Cohen as star
en.summary: Director Quentin Tarantino is bringing his first stage play, a swashbuckling comedy, to London's West End with actor Sacha Baron Cohen in the lead role.

stories.title: Quentin Tarantino play The Popinjay Cavalier to open at the West End’s Phoenix Theatre in February

en.title: Quentin Tarantino play The Popinjay Cavalier to open at the West End's Phoenix Theatre in February
en.summary: Tarantino's stage play "The Popinjay Cavalier," inspired by Old Hollywood swashbuckling tales, will open at the Phoenix Theatre in London's West End in February.

stories.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days

en.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
en.summary: A projectile struck Riyadh airport for the second time in two days, with the Iran-backed Houthi group from Yemen responsible for multiple attacks on the Saudi capital over the weekend.

stories.title: Riyadh airport hit again after deadly Houthi missile attack, Saudi authorities say

en.title: Riyadh airport hit again after deadly Houthi missile attack, Saudi authorities say
en.summary: An unidentified projectile struck Riyadh's King Khalid airport terminal, killing one person and injuring 11, marking the second attack in two days by Yemen's Houthi rebel group backed by Iran.

stories.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent

en.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
en.summary: Ukraine's president expressed initial surprise at Donald Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire but stated he would support such an agreement if Russia does the same. Russia has not yet responded to the proposal.

stories.title: Trump faces Republican opposition to his diesel deal with Russia’s Putin

en.title: Trump faces Republican opposition to his diesel deal with Russia's Putin
en.summary: Lawmakers from both parties are opposing a diesel agreement between Trump and Putin, arguing it would fund Putin's military campaign in Ukraine and breach US law.

stories.title: Putin has already broken Trump's 'energy ceasefire' with attack on power plant, says Zelenskyy

en.title: Putin has already broken Trump's 'energy ceasefire' with attack on power plant, says Zelenskyy
en.summary: Ukraine's president accused Russia of attacking Ukrainian power plants and energy infrastructure, claiming this violated Donald Trump's announced energy ceasefire agreement.

stories.title: Oil chiefs pull out of Riyadh energy congress after airport missile strike

en.title: Oil chiefs pull out of Riyadh energy congress after airport missile strike
en.summary: Major oil companies including BP are withdrawing from the World Petroleum Council meeting in Riyadh following a Houthi missile attack on an airport that killed 12 people.

stories.title: EU ‘safeguards’ hybrid car sector from Chinese imports under new deal

en.title: EU 'safeguards' hybrid car sector from Chinese imports under new deal
en.summary: The EU has reached an understanding with Beijing to protect its hybrid vehicle industry from Chinese imports. While the automotive sector backs the arrangement, other industries contend that China's substantial trade surplus requires more comprehensive measures.

stories.title: US threatens to block arms for Ukraine over attacks on Russian refineries

en.title: US threatens to block arms for Ukraine over attacks on Russian refineries
en.summary: US officials are pressuring European capitals and Kyiv, threatening to withhold military aid to Ukraine in response to attacks on Russian refineries. The pressure follows Trump's fuel supply agreement with Putin.

stories.title: VW chief calls for France and Germany to co-operate on China car fightback

en.title: VW chief calls for France and Germany to co-operate on China car fightback
en.summary: Volkswagen's chief executive urged France and Germany to work together to counter Chinese competition in the automotive market ahead of the Paris Motor Show. He emphasized the companies' history of finding solutions through cooperation.

stories.title: Can Russia meet Trump’s diesel demands?

en.title: Can Russia meet Trump's diesel demands?
en.summary: Ukrainian military strikes have caused severe petrol shortages in Russia, the worst since the Soviet Union's collapse, though diesel supplies remain adequate to meet potential demands.
